notes: Runs execute sequentially. No other agent-driven compilation or test runs overlap timing.
mattn and modernc columns pool controls across three executables (15 samples each); each native time ratio uses its own run's matching mattn median.
CGO static means the SQLite engine is linked into the executable, not a fully static libc/musl executable.
PureGo is forced with sqlite_purego because mattn requires CGO in the benchmark executable.
modernc reports the same SQLite 3.54.1 source ID, with different compile options; it is not the same native binary.
No CPU affinity, frequency lock, background-load isolation or confidence intervals. Go heap metrics exclude some engine allocations.
The repeated PureGo run still has a late JSON control slowdown: PureGo median 11904ns, matching mattn 8360ns, pooled mattn 4435ns. Raw values are retained; ratios use matching controls.

exploratory_run.reason: Native and modernc controls both slowed during the initial full PureGo run (scans and large payloads). The complete PureGo run was repeated with identical settings; the initial log is retained for inspection. Control pooling uses only the three selected raw logs.
